messages:
anya: Quick sync — I opened #PR (https://git.company/repo/compare/feat/quota-visibility) to adjust how we emit per-route quota hints. Can folks confirm expected client behavior before I merge?

sam: skimming the PR now. TL;DR: we add `X-Quota-Peek` (tokens) + keep `X-RateLimit-Reset` for reset timestamps, and we want SDKs to treat `X-Quota-Peek` as advisory only, right? :thinking: 

anya: yes. Advisory only. The idea: let clients show a soft-burst indicator but not treat it as a hard blocker. If `X-Quota-Peek` absent, fall back to remaining/limit math.

mike: question — do we still send `Retry-After` and return 429 bodies the same way? Some mobile SDKs rely on `retry_after` in JSON body.

jess: mobile SDKs expect a numeric `retry_after` in seconds inside body. We shouldn't break that.

anya: we keep `Retry-After` header *and* `retry_after` in the body for backwards compat. Example 429 we will emit: 
```http
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 1
X-Quota-Peek: 12/100
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "error": "rate_limited",
  "retry_after": 1.0
}
```

sam: ok. Two followups: 1) should SDKs stop surfacing `X-RateLimit-Burst`? 2) how do we version this so older clients don't mis-interpret `X-Quota-Peek`?

anya: 1) yes, `X-RateLimit-Burst` is deprecated — we emit it for a transitional window but mark as deprecated in headers (see PR notes). 2) we embed a header `X-Quota-Schema: v2` when `X-Quota-Peek` is present. Older clients ignore unknown headers, so safe.

mike: can we add a short compatibility table to the PR description for SDK owners? I can paste snippets for node/python/android.

anya: please do. Also need a quick design blurb for console folks — they're worried about showing a short-lived green "burst available" pill that disappears mid-request.

jess: console: make it display only if `X-Quota-Peek` > 0 for the last successful non-429 request within 5s. That avoids flicker on in-flight requests.

sam: routing question: per-route quotas mean that a request could be allowed by global capacity but hit per-route 429. We should ensure the 429 body includes `route_id` so client telemetry can attribute.

anya: good call — add `route_id` in the JSON body and `X-Route-Id` header. Example 429 body update: 
```json
{
  "error": "rate_limited",
  "retry_after": 1.0,
  "route_id": "chat.generate.v3"
}
```
and header `X-Route-Id: chat.generate.v3`

mike: SDK change: we'll map `route_id` to the request span tag and increment local per-route counters. I'll open SDK PRs after this merges.

jess: small ops question — how long do we keep emitting `X-RateLimit-Burst`? Ops/clients need a clear sunset date to coordinate rollouts.

anya: propose 90 days from merge + a deprecation announcement in #announcements. Ops can flip a flag to continue emitting if an enterprise customer needs more time.

sam: LGTM on the header/body shape. One nit: `X-Quota-Peek` format — you used `12/100`. prefer `12;limit=100` (parsable tokens) or `12/100`?

anya: I'd rather keep the concise `12/100` but add `X-Quota-Format: simple-fraction` header for clarity during rollout. If parsing issues arise we can change to `12;limit=100` in next major.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: infra-stage -> canary at 2029-06-01T15:00:00Z (job #4021) :rocket:

jess: heads-up to oncall: you'll see new headers in canary logs. We should have an observability alert if `X-Quota-Peek` exists but `X-Quota-Format` missing (to catch legacy emitters).

mike: I'll add an alert and a small dashboard card for per-route peek distributions.

anya: thanks all. Action items: sam/mike update SDK PR notes, jess announce deprecation timeline in #announcements, mike add dashboard/alert, I will add compatibility table to this PR and merge after CI green. :thumbsup:

sam: ping me when CI passes, I'll do a quick API-spec review.

mike: noted. will follow up once SDK PRs are up.

jess: will draft announcement after merge.

anya: merging in ~2h if no objections. Thanks!
